_comment: Items the audit cannot measure (unknown background, unparsed colour, gradient text) that a person has checked by eye. summarize.mjs fails the gate for any such item not listed here. Entry: { kind: unknown|unparsed|gradientText, route: <routes.json label>, width?: 1280|375 (omit = both), text?: start of the text ('*' = every item of that kind on the route), selector?: exact selector, reason: why it cannot be measured, verifiedBy: who checked it, how (screenshot path, ratio read with a colour picker), and when }. Do not add entries without a by-eye check.

signedOff.reason: Plan price uses background-clip:text with a vertical white-to-#a0a0a0 gradient; it cannot be measured as a single colour.
signedOff.verifiedBy: Task 8 implementer (Claude), by eye on 2026-10-04 in the Browser pane at 127.0.0.1:3100; worst stop #a0a0a0 on the opaque #060910 card is about 7.5:1 (>= 3:1 required, the text is 44px bold); legible in the 1280 screenshot.

signedOff.reason: Photo-stack tags (GravityHome.tsx) of cards that are overlapped by the front cards; hit-testing finds an opaque card above the text at every sample point, so the text is mostly not visible.
signedOff.verifiedBy: Task 8 implementer (Claude), by eye on 2026-10-04 in the Browser pane at 127.0.0.1:3100; each tag is white on a bg-black/75 pill, which is at least 10:1 even over a white photo; the visible tags are legible in the dashboard screenshot.

signedOff.reason: Composer card: an inline translucent amber radial gradient (max 9% alpha, GravityCreate.tsx) sits behind the label and placeholders; the auditor treats a gradient layer as an image of unknown colour.
signedOff.verifiedBy: Task 8 implementer (Claude), by eye on 2026-10-04 in the Browser pane at 127.0.0.1:3100; the auditor measures 4.76 / 5.21 / 5.39 on the colour beneath, and the 9% amber tint over the panel (#fef7eb) gives about 5.4:1 for #6d6250 and #9a5a00.
